spanish: Estas harán ustedes a Jehová en sus tiempos señalados, aparte de sus votos y sus voluntarias, a sus holocaustos y a sus minjot y a sus libaciones y a sus pazes.

findings.issue: Common noun מנחה (gift/grain offering) is left as the untranslated Hebrew-form plural minjot.
Feminine plural noun of a freewill offering is only the adjective voluntarias, which can be read as women.
Peace-offering noun is the irregular plural pazes, so the offering sense is unclear.
Demonstrative is common plural; Estas fixes feminine gender.

notes: 2mp as harán ustedes and sus is licensed address.
